snippet.title: Soccerverse | Beginner's Guide
snippet.description:
New to Soccerverse? No problem! This beginner’s guide breaks down the core gameplay to give you a quick introduction to this ground-breaking new management and trading simulator.

Are you ready to build your football empire with others?

Play for free now, anytime, anywhere: https://play.soccerverse.com/ 

Find out more: https://soccerverse.com/ 

Follow #Soccerverse for more information: 
• X / (Formerly Twitter): / @Soccerverse 
• Discord: / @Soccerverse 
• Facebook: / @Soccerverse 
• Tik Tok: / @PlaySoccerverse
